items.title: Hero dish · Butter Chicken
items.caption: One dish, one sunburst, one big name: the scroll-stopper template for every fan favourite.

items.title: Zone feature · Biryani Boulevard
items.caption: Turns the menu into a map: each zone gets its own street sign, so a series of these reads like a walk through the District.

items.title: Spice meter · Pick your heat
items.caption: A five-chilli scale guests can screenshot; it answers the top review theme (heat levels) with honest copy: even Mild has a kick.

items.title: Daily special · template
items.caption: Fill-in template: swap the dish art, name, one-liner and badges each day; no prices by design, so it never goes stale.

items.title: Ratings card · as listed publicly
items.caption: Only sourced public ratings, dated and labelled, with no invented quotes; social proof that stays true.

items.title: Order online · QR call-to-action
items.caption: One job, one action: a big pickup CTA and a QR slot (shown as a non-scannable sample; QR → ordering link at production).

items.title: Catering · party platters
items.caption: Sells the occasion, not a price: bunting, a loaded spread and the occasions people actually book for.

items.title: Did you know · what “dum” means
items.caption: Save-bait education post (menu words, decoded) using only generic, accurate food facts; no claims about the kitchen.

items.title: Staff pick · template
items.caption: Puts the friendly team (a top review theme) in the feed: swap in a real photo, name and role (with consent); the dish line stays brand voice, never a fake quote.

items.title: Motion · Garma-garam steam
items.caption: Six-second loop: steam curls off a wok of Chilli Chicken while the sunburst turns; motion stops the scroll, the dish does the selling.

items.title: Motion · Spice sparkle burst
items.caption: Three sparkle bursts per loop pop off a wobbling chilli: pure Bollywood-poster energy that still lands one clear line.

items.title: Motion · Today’s special wipe
items.caption: Template loop for the daily special: festival-colour bars wipe in the dish name (no price, ever); swap the name and art per day.

items.title: Story · Where do you land? (spice poll)
items.caption: Interactive poll frame (calendar Day 3): big, thumb-friendly options inside the safe zone; drop the native poll sticker over the cards.

items.title: Story · Guest-photo repost frame
items.caption: Branded frame for reposting guest photos (with permission, calendar Day 15); the guest’s photo drops into the polaroid.

items.title: Story · Swagat hai (visit us)
items.caption: Turns the illustrated District street into a visit card: our wordmark sits on the shop’s blank sign, address in the safe zone, no hours promised.

items.title: Story · Chai lo + ask us
items.caption: Question-box frame that leans on the friendly-team review theme: “Ask us what we’d order”, with the chai art doing the warm welcome.

items.title: Story safe-zone guide
items.caption: Every story keeps text out of the top 250px and bottom 340px (approx. app UI; verify in-app); decoration only lives there.
